description: Submit an evaluation job that simulates the listed cases against the agent, evaluates the conversations and optionally produces insights. Returns {job_id, status: QUEUED} - the work is asynchronous, so poll mba_get_eval_results with the job_id. Known limitation: eval_case_ids is read from the QUERY STRING, not the request body - pass it as the comma-separated argument here and this service puts it in the right place; the body is a separate object that accepts nothing else.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

eval_case_ids.description: Comma-separated eval case ids from list_eval_cases.

name: mba_start_eval_run
title: Start an evaluation run
